name: Chat with Agent
description: Send a message to an agent and synchronously await its next response on the session. Mints a new session when sessionId is omitted (returned in the response); continues an existing session when sessionId is supplied. A2A message/send analogue. Use this for conversational interactions where you need a reply. Use agent_request for tracked task delegation, or agent_message for fire-and-forget notifications. Several chats may be in flight on one session at once — they are not rejected; each awaits the agent's next response, and a response answers every message the agent had already seen, so quick successive messages may share one reply.

agentId.description: Agent reference: a bare name for the caller's agent, g/<id>, /g/<id>, or <ownerDID>/g/<id>

message.description: Message content to send to the agent. May be a string, structured object, or any JSON-serialisable value.

loads.description: Optional untrusted context to pre-load for the NEW session (the session tier of the context scope chain, #142): a map of key to entry spec, exactly as config.loads — {budget?, label?} under a lattice path or skill path, {skill: true} to pre-load a skill with its tools, or a spec declaring its own data source under any key: {text}, {op, input?} for a read-only operation observed before each inference and appended only when changed, or {job}. Non-skill values remain tool-result data; a caller-supplied trusted flag cannot grant system authority. Only valid when this call creates the session — an error if the session already exists.

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier (hex string, with or without a 0x prefix). Echo the sessionId returned by a previous chat to continue the conversation. If omitted, a new session is created and its id returned in the response. An unknown sessionId is rejected — omit to start a new session.

output.description: Agent's response to the chat message.

sessionId.description: Session the response belongs to (echo on subsequent chats to continue)

response.description: The agent's response value (whatever the transition emitted as its turn output)

answered.description: Ids of every chat Job this response answered, this one included, in presentation order — several when the agent read several queued messages before replying (#416)
